title: Kaizen feature manifest
description: Optional manifest at skills/<feature>/domain/manifest.yaml. Declares which conditional slots apply to this feature, so validate.py can check only the relevant subset of the canonical shape. When absent, validate.py infers predicates from filesystem presence.

name.description: Feature slug (kebab-case). Matches the skill dir name.

version.description: Feature version (semver). Independent of plugin.json version.

predicates.description: Which feature-shape predicates apply. Drives validate.py's slot requirements.

ops.description: When feature_has_multiple_ops: true, list the operation suffixes (e.g. ['promote', 'audit', 'evolve']).

env_knobs.description: Declared env variables the feature reads. Used by docs generators and the wiring-checklist.
